offering_description.value: Operates acute care hospitals and outpatient facilities that provide emergency, surgical and other medical care. It also treats children and adults with mental health and substance use disorders in inpatient, residential and outpatient settings.

primary_services.value: inpatient medical and surgical care; emergency care; outpatient medical care; inpatient and residential behavioral healthcare; outpatient mental health and addiction treatment

customer_segment.value: B2C: Patients and families seeking hospital, outpatient, mental health or addiction care; B2B: Commercial insurers and managed care organizations that contract for patient care; B2G: Public healthcare purchasers, including UK National Health Service commissioners

end_markets.value: acute hospital care; outpatient medical care; mental healthcare; substance use disorder treatment

revenue_model.value: healthcare reimbursement: Commercial insurers and public health programs pay for hospital, outpatient and behavioral healthcare; service fees: Patients pay directly for self-pay care and their share of covered treatment

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Clinical teams provide medical, surgical and behavioral healthcare to patients; asset operator: Operates hospitals, outpatient clinics and residential treatment facilities for patients and healthcare purchasers

geography_served.value: global: United States, including Puerto Rico, and the United Kingdom

specialization.value: related lines: Acute hospital care, outpatient medical care and behavioral health treatment

distribution_channels.value: own locations: Hospitals, outpatient clinics and residential treatment centers; other: Patient referrals from physicians, hospitals and behavioral health professionals

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Facility licensing and oversight by US state agencies, Medicare participation rules and UK care regulators
